title: The Boundary Through Time
_config_hash_note: computed with an EXPLICIT UTF-8 read; under the Windows default cp1252 the same file hashes to 2e15b95e. See REPORT.md section 8.4.
_changes_nothing: No boundary rule adopted, no parameter tuned, no cutoff applied, no decision appended, no sub-burst re-derived. docs/Universe-Decisions.md not touched.

gate.name: frame pipeline reproduces 10c's committed boundary
gate.method: float equality, not a tolerance, at the full-window frame
gate.second_check: on every one of the 9,605 frames carrying a boundary, the top of the enumerated ladder is asserted equal to 10c's own envelope_boundary() on the same input

headline_metrics.name: share_of_frames_with_3_or_more_surviving_peaks
headline_metrics.interpretation: The void parameter grades a trough against two flanking peaks, a construction that presumes two modes. At frame resolution the distribution is richly multimodal, so a frame offers a median of 7 candidate troughs (peaks median 8) and argmax picks one.

headline_metrics.name: share_of_candidates_at_or_above_100ms
headline_metrics.interpretation: Candidate boundaries DO reach tradeable timescales; the argmax winners mostly do not. Reference lines are read-off guides, never criteria.

headline_metrics.name: median_absolute_boundary_by_ladder_rank_ms
headline_metrics.interpretation: THE COARSE CANDIDATE IS NOT THE RUNNER-UP -- it is rank 5 and below. Median location rises monotonically with rank by a factor of 35 while void falls smoothly. The ladder is a gradient, not a two-horse race.

headline_metrics.name: winner_runnerup_relationship
headline_metrics.interpretation: argmax often chooses between near-ties, but between near-ties AT THE SAME SCALE. The runner-up is coarser barely more often than a coin flip.

headline_metrics.name: T4c_stationary_or_shifting
headline_metrics.interpretation: The position on the shape moves about twice as much as the normalization denominator, and the two partly cancel. Adjacent frames share 87.5% of their data yet the winner relocates by more than a decade between 17.5% of them -- that is switching between candidates, not tracking a moving shape.

cross_kernel_partial_read.interpretation: 3.8x rise across a 16x kernel range -- neither flat (structural) nor 1:1 with the window. The local median does NOT scale with the kernel, so the rise is not the denominator. THREE POINTS CANNOT SEPARATE THESE; labelled partial.

T3d_layout.decisive_fact: The three kernels do not share a bin grid -- each cell's grid comes from its own full-session normalized range (AMCX 83/79/76 bins, ZENA 86/88/90, all over different ranges). Layout B therefore needs three x-axes and its panels cannot be compared bin-for-bin, which is the one thing a combined layout is for. It also resamples 193 native frames to 121.
T3d_layout.note: Cooper already chose combined_comparative_3_panel at 10c T6c. Nothing is changed; this is recorded for whoever builds the next one.

decisions_recorded.why: It is the window definition 10c's T1 uses for the local median and the one s1_t6_animation.py's docstring states. Cost is the 52-59% thin share, reported rather than engineered away.
It is 10c's own grid, so the full-window frame reproduces 10c exactly (the T1d gate); and a per-frame grid would make a stationary distribution appear to move, the defect T3b bans for the axis range.

A cost guard set deliberately above the binding point (3,841 natural frames at the 2-min kernel). A cap that coarsened the 2-min kernel would degrade exactly the kernel where the boundary moves fastest.

surprises: The distribution is not bimodal at frame resolution -- 99.8% of frames carrying a boundary hold 3+ surviving peaks, median 8. Only 4 of 2,308 frames are the two-peak case the void parameter's construction presumes.

Coarse candidates exist in quantity (26.5% of all candidates >= 100 ms) but sit at ladder rank 5+, not at rank 1. The runner-up is coarser than the winner only 56.2% of the time and sits within 2% of it.
The winner relocates by more than a decade between 17.5% of adjacent frames that share 87.5% of their data.
10c DID build the animated histogram (T6a-d, 56 events, s1_06_animation_full/, 113 files) and Cooper DID choose the layout at T6c. The prompt describes both as deferred.

research/phase_10c/s1_t6_animation.py's docstring says the frame window is [t-kernel/2, t+kernel/2] and that peaks are detected per frame. The code uses a ~60-minute window against an 8-minute kernel and detects no peaks per frame at all -- it draws density against a fixed global threshold line.

Third hash-reproducibility defect in this lineage: config/phase_10d_diag1.json hashes differently under cp1252 (2e15b95e) than UTF-8 (0879d61c) because its _why strings are non-ASCII. config/phase_10d.json is pure ASCII and was unaffected. Config hashes here are reproducible only if BOTH encoding and line endings are pinned.

D1_R2_rule_adopted_or_tuned.observed: none; reference lines enter no computation

causal_status: NON-CAUSAL throughout. Centered window; every frame reads forward by half a kernel. Nothing here is a detector, a signal or an operating point. 10c retired 0 of v4's 16 non-causal fields, 10d retired 0, this diagnostic retires 0. Debt parked for Phase 17.
